caption: Billing during the Pro trial: annual billing is the default, and $174.00 is due when the trial ends on 3 December 2026. If you do not cancel, day 14 bills a full year. Workspace and billing details are hidden.
One prompt about a small bakery gave a polished 8 slide deck in about 55 seconds. It uses placeholders such as [Bakery Name] instead of figures, so every number is yours to fill in.
Switching the Revenue Drivers slide to a list layout dropped the bar chart and the 68% figure. The Smart Slide layouts decide what stays on the slide.
Export offers a view link, Offline Player, PDF, PowerPoint and Google Slides. We downloaded nothing, so the quality of the exported files is untested.
Manage plan: Pro at $14.50 a month billed annually, Team at $40 a month for 3 seats, and Enterprise on request. Cancel plan sits right on the Pro card.
Cancelling took 3 clicks over 2 screens, with no discount or pause offer, and the trial ended at once. The first of those screens pointed to Beautiful.ai inside ChatGPT.
